data.description: The Comfy Gazebo is a wooden garden gazebo with an eight-sided base, a sloped roof, railings around the sides and coloured window panels under the roof edge. The side view shows seating inside, so it works as a shaded sitting area in a park, a resort lawn or a society garden. Placed near a play area, it gives parents a place out of the sun while they watch their children. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range, which also includes the Repose Gazebo and two pergola designs. The listed colour is Sand Beige. Size, seating capacity and warranty terms come with the quote. Ask us to place the Comfy Gazebo on your layout drawing.

items.pText: The Comfy Gazebo is a wooden garden gazebo with an eight-sided base, a sloped roof, railings around the sides and coloured window panels under the roof edge. The side view shows seating inside, so it works as a shaded sitting area in a park, a resort lawn or a society garden. Placed near a play area, it gives parents a place out of the sun while they watch their children. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range, which also includes the Repose Gazebo and two pergola designs. The listed colour is Sand Beige. Size, seating capacity and warranty terms come with the quote. Ask us to place the Comfy Gazebo on your layout drawing.

A gazebo needs a level, well-drained base, and we usually grout it so it stays fixed in strong wind. The roof and posts should be checked for loose fixings after the monsoon. Keep gutters and the floor clear of leaves, and recoat exposed wood as part of regular upkeep.
